name: Barry Loudermilk
summary: Barry Dean Loudermilk ( LOW-dər-MILK; born December 22, 1963) is an American politician from the state of Georgia who has been the United States House representative from Georgia's 11th congressional district since 2015. Prior to this, Loudermilk served in the Georgia House of Representatives (2005–2010) and the Georgia Senate (2011–2013). Loudermilk stepped down from the Georgia Senate to run for Phil Gingrey's congressional seat in the 11th district.
